bg.$description: The page. Only the page itself; cards sit on raised.

raised.$description: Cards, frames, fields and anything lifted off the page.

raised-hover.$description: A raised surface under the pointer. Not a resting colour.

ink.$description: Headings and the subject of a sentence. Never a whole paragraph.

text.$description: Reading and interface text, 5.8:1 on bg.

underline.$description: Link underlines at rest; ink on hover.

line.$description: Hairlines and dividers, white at 6%. Not for card edges, which use edge.

image-ring.$description: The 1px inner outline on images and video only.

default.$description: The edge of every card, frame and button. Replaces borders.

hover.$description: The stronger edge for hover, faded in on a layer above. Never transition box-shadow to reach it.

lifted.$description: Only for a stack or a featured card that lifts on hover. Other cards use edge-hover.

media.$description: Images and video inside a frame.

subject.$description: The subject of a sentence, in ink. The rest of the sentence stays at the reading weight.

travel.$description: Things moving across the page. Controls keep performance-ui's durations.

scale.$description: Shrink on press for buttons and tappable cards. Not for links.

blur.$description: The sticky header's backdrop blur. The only blur allowed by default.

response.$description: Gestures that land in open space only; never into a hard stop.

damping.$description: Pairs with response. Gestures into open space only.

volume.$description: The loudest any interface sound may be.

gap.$description: The shortest time between two sounds.
